caption: The drawing features a single object that appears to be an octagonal table with intricate geometric patterns on its surface and a decorative pedestal base. The tabletop is an elongated octagon with a dominant central square that contains a repeating pattern of small, raised pyramidal shapes in shades of brown and beige, arranged in a grid. Surrounding the central square are four elongated, rectangular panels, each adorned with motifs and outlined in gold and red colors, situated parallel to the table’s edges. The outer border of the tabletop is wide and consists of different shades of reddish-brown, with gold and dark brown accents creating a banded effect. The table stands on a cylindrical, brown central column that widens into an ornate pedestal base, which has three lion paw-like extensions, also rendered in brown with lighter highlights. The background is plain and unadorned.
title: Inlaid Wood Table
